summary.text: Ron Bolton, a Republican, has represented District 61 in the Alabama House of Representatives since November 2022 and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.

paragraphs.text: His career experience includes working as a captain with the Northport Police Department and as managing principal of The Warwick Group LLC.
He has served as camp secretary of Gideons International and on the board of directors of Tuscaloosa Shooting Sports Inc.
